references.context: Commutative algebra: subring of S containing the image of R with inherited ring operations

references.phrase: all elements integral over image of R
references.disposition: The quantified set comprehends integral elements inside S; the ambient ring S is part of the definition.

review_rationale: Read the definition relative to the specified ring homomorphism R→S. The closure consists of elements of S integral over the image of R; it is not the absolute integral closure of a field or the integral closure inside an unspecified fraction field.
